title: Additive cycle lift and bijective homology map for beta
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact separated scheme, $U_i$ a finite open covering whose positive-length tuple intersections are affine, $I$ an injective resolution of the lifted additive structure sheaf, and $n\geq0$. Write $C$ for the ordinary unit module Cech complex and $T$ for the additive resolution total, as in [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization]. There exist additive homomorphisms $c:Z^n(C)\to Z^n(T)$ and $b:H^n(C)\to H^n(T)$ such that $b$ is bijective, $i_T(c(z))=\beta^n(i_C(z))$ for every cycle $z$, and $b(\pi_C(z))=\pi_T(c(z))$ for every cycle $z$. Here $i$ denotes cycle inclusion, $\pi$ the homology quotient and $\beta$ the explicit coefficient augmentation of that definition node.

proof.text: Apply exists_additiveCech_beta_quasiIso to obtain the actual lifted coefficient chain map q, its component equation with beta, and its quasi-isomorphism property. The cover and compactness hypotheses are retained in the statement but are not needed at this step.

Let F be forgetting scalars followed by ULift. Mathlib ShortComplex.mapCyclesIso and mapHomologyIso applied to the degree-n short complex identify the cycles and homology of F(C) with F of the original cycles and homology. Exactness of the two functors supplies their preservation instances. The private helper mapHomologyIso_inv_π proves compatibility of these isomorphisms with homology projection, by expanding the left-homology-data comparison formulas.

Define c by lifting with AddEquiv.ulift.symm, applying the inverse cycle comparison and cyclesMap q. Define b from AddEquiv.ulift.symm and the additive equivalence of the composite inverse homology comparison with isoOfQuasiIsoAt q n. This gives bijectivity. mapCyclesIso_hom_iCycles, cyclesMap_i and the component equation of q give the beta cycle formula. The private projection-compatibility helper and homologyπ_naturality give the representative formula. These categorical formulas work also in degree zero and for zero or empty complexes.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_additiveCechBeta_homology
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [X.IsSeparated]
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι), IsAffineOpen (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n →+
      (additiveCechTotal U I).cycles n,
    ∃ b : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).homology n →+
      (additiveCechTotal U I).homology n,
      Function.Bijective b ∧
      (∀ z, (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n (c z) = additiveCechBeta U I n
        ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z)) ∧
      (∀ z, b ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).homologyπ n z) =
        (additiveCechTotal U I).homologyπ n (c z))
